target.title: fix(ui): reject nondecimal strings in config form number coercion
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Control UI config form coerces string input back to schema-typed numbers with a bare `Number(...)`, which accepts nondecimal spellings. Two entry paths silently persist a value that differs from what the user typed, with no error surfaced:

1. Plain `type="number"` controls convert at the input handler (`ui/src/components/config-form.node.ts`: `Number(raw)` → `patchForm`). The HTML number grammar allows `1e5`-style spellings, so typing `1e5` stores the number `100000` in form state before any schema-aware code runs.
2. Text controls (mixed `string|number` unions, array items) keep the string into `patchForm`, but `coerceNumberString` at serialize time (`ui/src/lib/config/index.ts`) also used a bare `Number(trimmed)`, so `0x10`/`0b1010`/`1e3` spellings were silently reinterpreted there too.

In both cases `openclaw.json` ends up with a number the user never typed: `1e5` → `100000`, `0x10` → `16`, `0b1010` → `10`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Apply one strict decimal gate (`/^-?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)$/`) at the earliest input-normalization boundary and keep the typed text until schema validation decides:

- The regex + coercion helper now lives in `ui/src/components/config-form.shared.ts` (`coerceConfigFormNumberString`) and is used by both number-input handlers in `config-form.node.ts` (plain number/integer fields and number-only unions) before any `Number()` conversion, and by the serialize-time coercion in `ui/src/lib/config/index.ts`. One canonical implementation, no duplicated grammar.
- Nondecimal spellings flow into form state as the original string. At submit they stay strings, so the gateway's Zod validation rejects them with a visible "Save failed" + Retry instead of silently storing a reinterpreted number. Union fields with a string variant accept the text verbatim — same "typed text preserved, schema arbitrates" behavior on both paths.

This mirrors the merged nondecimal-reject pattern: #107480 (`parseCronEveryMs` rejects `0x10`/`1e3`/`+1` in cron repeat amounts) and #105158 (`parseStrictFiniteNumber` rejects hex `--cpus 0x10` in fleet). Exponent notation is treated as nondecimal per #107480. Leading `+` is rejected (JSON number grammar has no `+` sign); negative decimals, floats, and `.5`/`5.` spellings coerce exactly as before, and the existing finite/integer guards are untouched.

No new config/env/options.

## User Impact

- Typing `1e5` into a plain numeric config field no longer silently writes `100000` into `openclaw.json`; the typed text is preserved and rejected by schema validation where the user can see it.
- Same for `0x10`/`0b1010`/`1e3` in text-based numeric/union fields.
- Valid decimal input (`42.5`, `-7`, `.5`) behaves exactly as before.

## Evidence

### Real Control UI browser proof — plain `type="number"` field (head `068e147f5c`)

Real gateway from this branch's `dist/` (isolated `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, token auth, `gateway.mode: local`) + real Chromium (Playwright, `en-US`) driving the served Control UI via the tokenized dashboard URL — no mocks; the browser's autosave fired real `config.set` requests against real Zod validation. Field: Settings → AI & Agents → Agents → Agent Defaults → Compaction → "Compaction Reserve Tokens" (`agents.defaults.compaction.reserveTokens`, schema `integer`, rendered by the plain number-input handler).

Before (same branch with the fix stashed — i.e. previous head `17f11f49d6`, same build procedure): typing `1e5` shows the green **Saved** pill, the field redisplays the silently reinterpreted `100000`, and `openclaw.json` persists `"reserveTokens": 100000`.

![before: 1e5 silently saved as 100000 on a plain number field](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666/openclaw/releases/download/ui-proof-109675/r2-before-plain-number-1e5-saved-as-100000.png)

After (this PR): typing `1e5` shows **Save failed** + Retry, the field keeps the typed `1e5`, and nothing is persisted (`reserveTokens` absent from `openclaw.json`).

![after: 1e5 rejected with visible Save failed](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666/openclaw/releases/download/ui-proof-109675/r2-after-plain-number-1e5-rejected.png)

Typing `100000` afterwards coerces and saves as the number `100000`:

![after: valid decimal saves](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666/openclaw/releases/download/ui-proof-109675/r2-after-plain-number-decimal-saved.png)

Round-1 browser proof for the union-typed text-field path (`agents.defaults.compaction.maxActiveTranscriptBytes`, before = `origin/main` coercion): https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109675#issuecomment-5006380787

### Production-entry proof — real `createRuntimeConfigCapability` save flow

A standalone script (not committed) drives the real capability — `ensureLoaded` + `ensureSchemaLoaded` + `patchForm` + `save()` against a plain fake gateway client object — and inspects the exact `raw` bytes submitted to `config.set`. No test mocks anywhere in the path.

Before fix (`origin/main` @ `19b5e564d7`):

```json
{
  "hex-into-number-field": { "typed": "0x10", "submittedValue": 16, "submittedType": "number" },
  "binary-into-integer-field": { "typed": "0b1010", "submittedValue": 10, "submittedType": "number" },
  "exponent-into-number-field": { "typed": "1e3", "submittedValue": 1000, "submittedType": "number" },
  "hex-into-string|number-union": { "typed": "0x10", "submittedValue": 16, "submittedType": "number" },
  "valid-decimal-still-coerces": { "typed": "42.5", "submittedValue": 42.5, "submittedType": "number" },
  "valid-negative-still-coerces": { "typed": "-7", "submittedValue": -7, "submittedType": "number" }
}
```

After fix (this PR @ `068e147f5c`):

```json
{
  "hex-into-number-field": { "typed": "0x10", "submittedValue": "0x10", "submittedType": "string" },
  "binary-into-integer-field": { "typed": "0b1010", "submittedValue": "0b1010", "submittedType": "string" },
  "exponent-into-number-field": { "typed": "1e3", "submittedValue": "1e3", "submittedType": "string" },
  "hex-into-string|number-union": { "typed": "0x10", "submittedValue": "0x10", "submittedType": "string" },
  "valid-decimal-still-coerces": { "typed": "42.5", "submittedValue": 42.5, "submittedType": "number" },
  "valid-negative-still-coerces": { "typed": "-7", "submittedValue": -7, "submittedType": "number" }
}
```

### Control-red

Reverting the component half of the fix (restoring the bare `Number(raw)` in the number-input handlers) turns the new browser test red: the plain number input again patches `100000` instead of the typed `"1e5"`. With the fix, typed spellings survive verbatim into form state and into the submitted payload for schema validation to reject.

### Regression tests

- `ui/src/components/config-form.browser.test.ts` — plain number-input handlers: `1e5` → patched as string `"1e5"`, `42` → `42`, `42.5` into an integer field stays `"42.5"`, `42.5` into a number field → `42.5`, empty → `undefined`.
- `ui/src/lib/config/index.test.ts` — plain number/integer fields keep `0x10`/`0b1010`/`0o17`/`1e3`/`+5` as strings in the submitted `config.set` payload; string-or-number union fields keep `1e5`/`0x10` verbatim and coerce `42` → `42`; valid decimal spellings (`42.5`, `-7`, `.5`) still coerce.

### Test suite

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/lib/config/index.test.ts ui/src/components/config-form.browser.test.ts
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  89 passed (89)
```

### Lint / typecheck / diff hygiene

- `oxlint` on all 5 touched files: 0 findings.
- `tsgo -p tsconfig.ui.json` and the UI test tsconfig lane: 0 errors.
- `git diff --check` clean; 5 files (+139/-34): the decimal helper moves into `config-form.shared.ts` (used by both the input handlers and the serialize path), the two number-input handlers stop pre-converting with bare `Number()`, plus tests.
